note: Side Quests: real situations people actually deal with. Played as live conversations. 'spicy' quests only appear in Unfiltered mode (18+).

quests.title: She's fading you at the bar
quests.setting: A loud bar on a Friday. You've been talking to her for five minutes and her answers are getting shorter. Her friend keeps looking over.
quests.opener: Yeah. Totally. Sorry, what were you saying?
quests.twist: She glances at her phone, then at her friend, and says she should probably get back.
quests.goal: Notice the fade and either re-spark it or exit with dignity.

quests.title: Sidewalk side quest
quests.setting: Saturday afternoon on a busy street. You stop someone who caught your eye outside a coffee shop. She has earbuds in and an iced coffee.
quests.opener: Oh! Hi? Sorry, did I drop something?
quests.twist: She says she has a boyfriend, half-smiling, maybe true, maybe not.
quests.goal: Open naturally in one line, read her answer, and take a no gracefully.

quests.title: Getting turned down
quests.setting: You just asked her out after a fun conversation at a friend's birthday.
quests.opener: Ah, that's really sweet. I just don't think I see it like that, you know?
quests.twist: Her friends are within earshot and clearly heard.
quests.goal: Take the no without sulking, pushing or over-explaining. Leave her comfortable.

quests.title: Splitting the bill
quests.setting: Group dinner, six people. You had a salad and water. Dev just suggested splitting evenly. Three people had steaks and cocktails.
quests.opener: Easiest thing is we just split it six ways, right? Like ninety each.
quests.twist: Someone says 'don't be that guy' as a joke.
quests.goal: Pay your share without being stingy or a pushover.

quests.title: Sending the food back
quests.setting: A busy restaurant. Your burger came well done; you asked for medium. The server is clearly slammed.
quests.twist: He says the kitchen is backed up and it'll be twenty more minutes.
quests.goal: Get it fixed without being a jerk or a doormat.

quests.title: He still owes you $200
quests.setting: Your friend borrowed $200 two months ago. He just posted a festival trip on his story.
quests.opener: Yo! You see the lineup? Insane, right?
quests.twist: He says 'bro I'll get you, why are you being weird about it.'
quests.goal: Bring it up directly, keep the friendship, get a date for the money.

quests.title: Roommate argument
quests.setting: Your roommate has had people over every night this week. You have an exam tomorrow. It's 12:40am.
quests.opener: Oh hey, man. You want a drink? We're just chilling.
quests.twist: He says 'you never said anything before, how was I supposed to know.'
quests.goal: Set the boundary tonight without starting a war.

quests.title: Getting roasted by the group
quests.setting: Pregame with friends. Someone brings up the time you tripped walking into the formal.
quests.opener: No but tell them what you said to the bouncer after. Tell them.
quests.twist: Everyone's waiting. The new girl in the group is laughing too.
quests.goal: Take the roast, land one back, don't get defensive.

quests.title: Your ex is at the party
quests.setting: House party. You turn around and your ex is right there with a drink. It's been four months.
quests.opener: Oh. Hey. Wasn't sure you'd be here.
quests.twist: Her new guy walks over and introduces himself.
quests.goal: Be warm, brief and unbothered. Exit cleanly.

quests.title: The bouncer says no
quests.setting: Line outside a club. Your friends are already inside. Your group is three guys.
quests.twist: He lets a different group straight in while you're standing there.
quests.goal: Stay composed. Try once, properly. Don't beg.

quests.title: Asking for her number
quests.setting: End of a good conversation at a bookstore cafe. She's packing up to leave.
quests.opener: Okay, I really have to go, but this was fun.
quests.goal: Ask clearly, once, without hedging or making it weird.

quests.title: "I'm not looking for anything serious"
quests.setting: Third date, back at a bar after dinner. Things have been flirty.
quests.opener: Okay, I feel like I should just say it. I'm not really looking for anything serious right now.
quests.twist: She asks what you're looking for. Directly.
quests.goal: Say what you actually want, honestly, without pressure or games.

quests.title: She asks your body count
quests.setting: Late night, second date, a few drinks in. The conversation turned to exes and she's grinning.
quests.opener: Okay, real question. What's your number? And don't lie.
quests.twist: She tells you hers and waits to see how you react.
quests.goal: Be honest and unbothered. Don't brag, don't judge, keep it light.

quests.title: The morning after
quests.setting: Her place, Sunday morning. You hooked up last night after meeting at a party. You're both a little awkward.
quests.opener: So... coffee? Or do you have to run?
quests.twist: She asks, half joking, if you're going to text her or disappear.
quests.goal: Be warm and clear about what you want next. No ghost energy.

quests.title: Your wingman ruined it
quests.setting: Bar. You were doing well with someone until Dev came over, drunk, and told her you'd been 'talking about her all night.'
quests.opener: What? I'm helping! She's into you, bro, relax.
quests.twist: She's still standing there, eyebrow raised, waiting to see what you say.
quests.goal: Recover with humor, own it, keep your cool in front of her.

quests.title: Getting your deposit back
quests.setting: Phone call with your landlord. He's keeping $600 of your deposit for 'wear and tear' that was there when you moved in.
quests.opener: Look, the walls needed repainting. That's standard.
quests.twist: He says 'take it to small claims if you want, see how that goes.'
quests.goal: Stay calm, cite facts, ask for exactly what you want.

quests.title: The barber cooked you
quests.setting: Barber chair. He's done and holds up the mirror. It's way shorter than you asked. He looks proud.
quests.opener: Clean, right? That's a good look on you.
quests.twist: He says it'll grow back in a week, no big deal.
quests.goal: Be honest about it without being rude. Get something fixed or credited.

quests.title: She left you on read
quests.setting: You run into the girl who left you on read last week. Campus dining hall.
quests.opener: Oh my god, hi. Sorry I never texted back, it's been the craziest week.
quests.twist: She asks if you want to sit with her and her friends.
quests.goal: Be easy about it. No guilt trip, no needy energy.
